title: Armed military mutiny, barracks takeover and coup actions
date: 2022-01-23/24; exact onset varies by reported action
reason: The available leads principally describe armed soldiers mutinying, military control of barracks or the state takeover, rather than a qualifying public civilian protest gathering. These armed state-actor/coup actions are not coded as civilian mass-mobilization events.
notes: Search-only material includes one possible image-caption lead to civilians supporting the army (S033); it does not establish a separate crowd’s onset, size, policy demand or response. Preserve that civilian lead as a gap, and do not transfer the military mutiny’s gunfire or demands to Jan22 or Jan25 civilian gatherings.

title: Advance notices, permit/ban and platform restrictions around the 22 January march
date: 2022-01-21/22 (notice/publication window; not a separate gathering date)
reason: Application/notice/ban and social-media restriction leads are not additional executed public gatherings. The reported 22 January gathering itself is retained separately as candidate E002.
notes: The notices do not add participant counts, an event end, or protest response observations. Do not count an announced conference or march as an occurrence.

title: Search-only report of bystanders awaiting an army announcement at Place de la Nation
reason: Provisional exclusion: the captured headline describes bystanders waiting for an army declaration, but the body was not read and the available metadata does not establish a qualifying protest or a demand directed to Burkina Faso authorities.
notes: Retain as a distinct 24 January lead, not as the 25 January gathering. This is a source-evidence limitation, not a finding that no crowd occurred; no turnout, demand, policy, end or response is coded.
